title: Transfer Volume and Statement Production for the Personal Sender Account
content:
Transfer volume for the statement of a Personal Sender Account is the number of payouts on the customer's personal transfers in the 12 months before the request date, an entry dated on the same calendar day 12 months earlier or before it no longer counting, counting every Bank Deposit payout sent, every Cash Pickup payout made and every Mobile Wallet credit sent.

| Payouts in the 12 months before the request date | Business days added to the counted statement window |
|---|---|
| 24 or more | 2 |
| at least 12 but fewer than 24 | 1 |
| fewer than 12 | 0 |

When it is 24 or more, 2 business days are added to the counted statement window; when it is at least 12 but fewer than 24, 1 business day is added; when it is fewer than 12, nothing is added for transfer volume.

## The entries counted

One payout is one payout entry in the ledger of a transfer: a payout sent entry on a Bank Deposit transfer, a payout made entry on a Cash Pickup transfer, or a credit sent entry on a Mobile Wallet transfer. The count is of entries, not of amounts, and the three delivery methods are added together.

## Cases (hypothetical)

| Bank Deposit payouts sent | Cash Pickup payouts made | Mobile Wallet credits sent | Total | Business days added |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 6 | 3 | 2 | 11 | 0 |
| 6 | 4 | 2 | 12 | 1 |
| 10 | 8 | 5 | 23 | 1 |
| 10 | 8 | 6 | 24 | 2 |
